title: System by Dave product manifest
description: products/<id>/product.json. The canonical declaration of a product: identity, version source, configuration surface, profile roles, storage and continuity capabilities. js/sbd-registry.js becomes generated, non-authoritative output of these manifests. See docs/client-framework.md.

changelog.description: Release log whose top entry is the running version (the camera-sim model). The version is read from here, never duplicated in the manifest.

kind.description: native: page in this repository. app: built from apps/<id> with its own build. external: managed export from another repository (not editable here).

registry.description: Fields copied into the generated js/sbd-registry.js entry for AV Suite products.

configSchema.description: Path to a JSON Schema for the client 'config' object. The product's entire client-configurable surface. Use {} semantics via a schema that accepts only an empty object when the product takes no configuration.

profileRoles.description: Roles the product accepts profiles for, and the profile kind each role requires.

keys.description: Namespaced keys this product owns, as templates: '{client}.camera-sim.v1'.

legacyKeys.description: Pre-framework keys still read or written (e.g. 'fmpCameraSim.v1'). Listed so transfer and migration tooling can find them; new products must not add any.

handoffReceive.description: Envelope payload schemas this product imports, e.g. 'system-by-dave.crew-time-log.v1'.

shellVersion.description: Version range of packages/sbd-shell this product's build integrates.
